item.title: Suspect in custody after Uber passenger killed in Philly crash: police
item.description: A man wanted in connection with a deadly crash involving an Uber in Philadelphia has surrendered to authorities. Officials say Joseph Cini, 35, is currently in the hospital. According to investigators, Cini was fleeing from police on Monday morning when he crashed into an Uber at Ninth and Girard in North Philadelphia.
